lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the reviewer's WARNING finding on test/integration/self-invoke-compiled.test.ts (both tests now declare an explicit { timeout: 30_000 } as the third arg of test(), matching the sibling convention already used in test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts:267 and others), closing the live CI-timeout flake risk on macos-latest cold-compiling a 63MB standalone binary. Only the WARNING was in scope for this fix story; the review round also recorded three non-blocking SUGGESTIONs (prd.json review.findings) that were left untouched as out-of-scope for US-R1-001: (1) test/retry/interactive.test.ts:48 restoring process.execPath/argv[1] with plain statements instead of try/finally, (2) src/util/self-invoke.ts:37 keying detection on the /$bunfs/ prefix instead of Bun.isStandaloneExecutable (confirmed genuinely unavailable on the repo's pinned bun 1.3.13), (3) test/util/self-invoke.test.ts:27 missing an empty-string argv1 boundary case. None of these are blocking findings; a future story may pick them up if the reviewer re-files them. All quality gates green: typecheck, bun test (5630 pass / 0 fail), bun run check:all (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps all ok).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs confirm test() accepts a third argument for per-test timeout, either a plain number (ms) or an options object (the { retry, repeats } examples use the object form); the default is 5000ms if unspecified. The { timeout: 30_000 } object-literal form used in this fix matches the documented API and the existing sibling-test convention in the repo (orch-recycle-watch.test.ts, issue-file-on-main.test.ts, etc.).
